payload.recallText: A teacher or someone is taking kids on a oregon trail hike. She is trying to make it as realistic and dangerous as possible. She gave water because she was afraid of getting into some kind of trouble. There was a lot of typos in the text and it was difficult to read, and it was too long. She wanted them to play realistic roles, they could not play as a pop star or anything like that. This was back in the 1850's.
